edges.reason: Constructor assigns owner from the untrusted msg.sender, establishing the privileged role.
transferOwnership is gated by onlyOwner comparing msg.sender to owner.
claimOwnership requires msg.sender == pendingOwner before transferring ownership.
pause is gated by the onlyOwner modifier checking msg.sender.
unpause is gated by the onlyOwner modifier checking msg.sender.
transfer reads and mutates balances indexed by the untrusted msg.sender.
transferFrom consumes the allowance granted to msg.sender.
approve writes the allowed mapping using msg.sender as the owner key.
increaseApproval updates the allowance keyed by msg.sender.
decreaseApproval updates the allowance keyed by msg.sender.
mint is gated by onlyOwner comparing msg.sender to owner.
finishMinting is gated by onlyOwner comparing msg.sender to owner.
burn checks and debits balances indexed by msg.sender.
pullOut is gated by onlyOwner comparing msg.sender to owner.
Constructor writes msg.sender into the owner state variable.
Constructor initializes pendingOwner to address(0).
transferOwnership writes newOwner into pendingOwner.
claimOwnership promotes pendingOwner into owner.

unpause sets the paused flag to false.
totalSupply returns the totalSupply_ state variable.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping.
allowance reads the allowed mapping.
transfer debits the sender and credits the recipient in balances.
transferFrom debits _from and credits _to in balances.
transferFrom reduces the spender allowance in the allowed mapping.
approve overwrites the allowed mapping entry.
increaseApproval adds to the allowed mapping entry.
decreaseApproval reduces or zeroes the allowed mapping entry.
mint increases the totalSupply_ state variable.
mint credits the recipient balance in the balances mapping.
finishMinting sets mintingFinished to true.
burn debits the caller balance in the balances mapping.
burn reduces the totalSupply_ state variable.
pullOut performs an external call into an attacker-supplied ERC20 token, enabling reentrant execution before state settlement.
The external token transfer forwards the owner address as the destination.
The user-supplied _token address is the target of the unsafe external call.
transfer performs SafeMath subtraction and addition on balances.
mint performs SafeMath addition on totalSupply_ and balances.
burn performs SafeMath subtraction on balances and totalSupply_.
transfer._to feeds the destination of the balance credit.

mint._amount is added to supply and balance.
burn._value is the amount destroyed from the caller balance.
pullOut._amount is forwarded to the external token transfer.
